Package com.egradx.files.spi

Interface EgradxFileAccessPolicy

public interface EgradxFileAccessPolicy
The application's own check for files attached to one kind of its records (attachedType(): order, ticket, …). Register one bean per type. Without one, the built-in permissions decide. 
 @Bean
 EgradxFileAccessPolicy orderFiles(OrderService orders) {
     return EgradxFileAccessPolicy.of("order", request -> orders.canSee(request.userId(), request.attachedId())
             ? Decision.DEFAULT : Decision.DENY);
 }
